## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      5 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 27 juin 2026 - 13 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Vanessalikescake_, 13 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Every time I do a workout it freezes and goes on a loop without finishing the workout routine. It’s frustrating and causing me to waste a lot of time."
            2. _Beef_Curtains_, 13 sept. 2026, 1/5: "When i synced it to my google health app it doubled all my steps and there was no fixing it. I tried for hours but its broken. Feels like i lost all my hard-work and data because of a dumb technical glitch."
            3. _SarahCelebrian_, 2 sept. 2026, 2/5: "I got a Fastest 5k award for a 3.5km run and according to the award I ran the 5k in 20 minutes which doesn’t match the workout so no idea where it’s coming from. This is annoying because now I can’t see my actual fastest time or when it was. Very disappointing that there’s no easy way to report bugs like this. I’d expected better from Apple"
